dct_description_sm: When we began the Inuit Mental Health and Adaptation to Climate Change project, we did not set out to make a film, or to tell the story in this way. It evolved from the realization that in order to make a difference and in order to reach people, we needed to find a medium that would let the voices and wisdom of Inuit in Nunatsiavut, Labrador to shine through, and to introduce people to the beauties of Inuit culture and the environments in which they live. Film was the perfect medium!
